subject.title: Follow-up: optimize fallback order + add model-input config guardrail

question: What should be the authoritative policy for fallback ordering and configured model input capabilities?
rationale: Current code supports explicit operator-ordered fallbacks and mixed capability metadata surfaces; changing either to fail fast or auto-rank can break existing provider setups without a maintainer policy decision.

options.title: Keep split tracker and decide policy first
options.body: Keep this issue open for the benchmark/order policy while the narrower guardrail issue owns capability validation design and tests.

options.title: Collapse into the guardrail issue
options.body: Move any remaining fallback-order acceptance criteria into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/50287 and close this issue only after maintainers accept that narrower scope.

options.title: Document explicit order only
options.body: Leave configured fallback order operator-owned, document the tradeoff, and limit implementation to warnings or diagnostics for contradictory capability metadata.

recommendation.title: Keep split tracker and decide policy first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for the benchmark/order policy while the narrower guardrail issue owns capability validation design and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans model fallback policy, provider metadata, docs, and compatibility boundaries where steipete has the strongest recent history signal.
